## Scope and evidence

- Stage / single Owner:
- User-visible goal:
- Source manifest / upstream version (do not invent):
- Files changed:
- Verification command and actual CI run URL:
- Negative cases and backward compatibility:
- Known blockers / undecided items:

- [ ] No secrets, personal student data or database backups.
- [ ] No direct A/B database access from I or U.
- [ ] No `main` direct push or bypass; PR tests really executed.
- [ ] No Stage approval inferred from successful document-only QA.
